alt: A list of numbers scanned once, left to right. Beside it, a set grows by one value each time the current number is new. When a number already in the set is read, the scan stops there and reports that number as the first duplicate; if the scan finishes with no repeat, the seen set holds every distinct value read.

steps.caption: Before scanning, the seen set is empty. Nothing has been read yet.
1 at position 0 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 1 value.
2 at position 1 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 2 values.
3 at position 2 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 3 values.
2 at position 3 is already in seen, so it is the first duplicate. The scan stops here.
Before scanning, the seen set is empty. Nothing has been read yet.
1 at position 0 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 1 value.
2 at position 1 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 2 values.
3 at position 2 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 3 values.
4 at position 3 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 4 values.
5 at position 4 is not in seen, so it joins the set: seen now has 5 values.
The scan reached the end with no repeat, so first_dup stays -1.
